# Vodwise

> Vodwise is a Windows desktop app that works as a live-stream copilot and automatic editor for streamers on Twitch, Kick and YouTube. During the stream it unifies chat, helps with moderation, alerts and OBS scenes, and answers when the streamer talks to it. After the stream it works through the recording on the streamer's own PC and prepares the full video with chapters, a highlights cut and vertical clips with subtitles, plus titles, descriptions and thumbnails. Nothing is published without the streamer's approval.

Current status (November 2026):

- Under construction. The public Windows download is not available yet; the download page shows the real state.
- Platforms in use today: Twitch, Kick and YouTube. TikTok and Instagram are under construction and not available.
- Pricing works with credits: plans with credits included and top-ups that never expire. Current details are on the pricing page.
- The site is available in Spanish, English and Portuguese.

Key facts:

- Runs on Windows 10 and 11 together with OBS.
- The recording is edited on the streamer's own PC, not on a web editor. To analyse it, the recording is processed by AI providers as the privacy policy explains.
- Clip tools turn a video you give them into short clips; stream tools focus on alerts, overlays and the bot. Vodwise covers both in one app and also builds the long video for YouTube.
- Made by Vodwise Labs, S.L.U. Contact: soporte@vodwise.com. X: @VodwiseX
